name: marketplace-family-pack
description: Codex plugin bundle that adapts the MARK-46 upstream skill families into market-consumable skills.

interface.shortDescription: Market-consumable Codex skills adapted from the MARK-46 upstream families.
interface.longDescription: Marketplace Family Pack turns the upstream MARK-46 family set into 13 repo-held Codex skills that can be consumed directly by a plugin marketplace. The bundle preserves provenance and license evidence while exposing actual installable skill assets.
defaultPrompt: Use the marketplace family pack to pick the right family skill for this work.
Review the upstream family asset and the bundled skill together.
Apply the family skill as the market-consumable surface, not the provenance note.
